Name: Trinket Hotswap
Author: PrimmR
Description:
[center][b]Trinket Hotswap - Swap equipped trinkets on the fly[/b]

Do you have two favourite trinkets and can never decide which one to equip?
Well now you don't have to!

Just press the action button [i](right click / x) [/i]while holding a trinket to eqiup it during gameplay.
If you already have a trinket equipped they will be swapped.


[i]Compatible with 1.6[/i][i]
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url]﻿[/i]


[i]﻿
